notes.title: Get QUEEN OF MOTHS at a discount and let’s celebrate pixel art games!
notes.notes:
[h1]QUEEN OF MOTHS is joining PixElated Fest on July 29th![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44199935/56e6e9b98875969dbd28706de664ec8a73bee459.png[/img]

We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that QUEEN OF MOTHS joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centred around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: Further fixes
Removal of broken ends
notes.notes:
Hi!

You can sometimes get lost in such a branching plot. It turned out that in a few cases a situation could arise in which it was impossible to continue the game. More such situations have been found and fixed :)

Regards!
Tomek Śmigielski,
Tesseract Games

notes.title: A few minor fixes
notes.notes:
Hi!

It turned out that in some situations, returning to the forest location made it impossible to continue playing. I managed to find this error and eliminate it. You won't be stuck in the forest again ;)

Regards!
Tomek Śmigielski,
Tesseract Games
